verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce issues agent-specific payment tokens/credentials scoped by mandate fields (declineThreshold amount, effectiveUntilTime, merchantName, exact transaction amount) and gated by passkey-authenticated user instructions, matching a least-privilege scoped-credential model for agents (supp-1, supp-2, supp-3, supp-5). Revocation via cancelling a purchase intent and per-request merchant/amount scoping are documented with concrete API fields, giving strong first-party evidence of granular, bounded credentials. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs, and confirmation the feature is fully production-mature rather than 'in the process of development and deployment'
